articles.title: Breaking Down the Ending of Love in Disguise
articles.summary: In an era that’s seen the K-drama industry shift focus toward more stories of suspense, thriller, and crime , the romantic comedy Love in Disguise marks a return to a familiar K-drama trope. articles.title: What Time Should You Eat Thanksgiving Dinner? Here’s What Etiquette Experts Say
articles.summary: As households across America prepare to gather for their Thanksgiving celebrations , there’s one question at the forefront of hosts’ minds: what time should dinner be served? articles.title: People Are Getting Worse at Handling Uncertainty
articles.summary: Living with the unknown isn’t always easy. Not knowing if layoffs are headed your way or whether you’ll be able to afford rent would be difficult for anyone. But when the pressure of the unknown becomes so intense it interferes with daily life, this “intolerance of uncertainty,” as psychologists call it, becomes a risk factor for mental-health disorders, primarily anxiety and depression.
